% Brackets matching

	(   L mod 2 =:= 0 ->

	).
 
stack_brackets([],_):-!.

	stack_brackets(T,S1).
stack_brackets([H|T],S):-

	append(M,[H],L),

stack_brackets([H|T],S):-
	member(H,[41,93,125]),
	non_member(H,[40,91,123]),
	!,

stack_brackets([_|T],S):-

non_member(E,L):-
